items.label: GE Vernova press release: Studsvik, GE Vernova Hitachi and Samsung C&T commit to (09-03-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Development agreement, not an order: after a competitive eva

set.signal: Development agreement, not an order: after a competitive evaluation, Studsvik selected GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy (GVH) and Samsung C&T as strategic collaborators for its ReFirm program - an initial four-unit BWRX-300 project of approximately 1,200 MWe (1.2 GW) at Nyköping or Valdemarsvik, Sweden, with the first unit expected to enter operation in the mid-2030s. The agreement is exclusive for a fixed period and is not a final investment decision or authorization to construct. GVH leads reactor engineering, licensing support and cost estimation and, with Samsung C&T, acts as the execution team; GE Vernova's Financial Services business participates in an advisory and financial structuring capacity.

items.reason: The release never describes GVH as a GE Vernova-Hitachi joint venture; that is background knowledge (no inferred ownership).
items.evidence: Studsvik has selected GE Vernova Hitachi Nuclear Energy and Samsung C&T as its strategic collaborators

items.label: Hubbell Morgan Stanley conference 2026 (09-17-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Beyond data centers (VP IR Dan Innamorato): through 2026 gro

set.signal: Beyond data centers (VP IR Dan Innamorato): through 2026 growth has broadened - light industrial has picked up and the long-soft non-residential side has picked up, with activity regionally mapping 'very closely to where data centers are going in'; heavy industrial is still a little softer. VP IR Dan Innamorato: utility capital budgets now reflect longer-duration projects in substation and transmission. CEO Gerben Bakker: visibility from utility customers is further out; Hubbell products are still relatively short lead time (weeks to a couple of months), but lead times are 'extending in some of the product lines where we're more constrained', and Hubbell is investing to bring them back down. On 765 kV it has 'one award already that we'll start shipping next year'.

items.reason: The utility capital-budget point was said by VP IR Dan Innamorato, not the CEO; the CEO said visibility is further out.
items.evidence: Dan Innamorato: We've seen utility capital budgets start to reflect some of these investments as we think about longer duration projects in areas like substation and transmission.

items.label: Hubbell Morgan Stanley conference 2026 (09-17-2026)
items.signal_prefix: 800 VDC and targets (CEO Gerben Bakker): Burndy grounding pr

set.signal: 800 VDC and targets (CEO Gerben Bakker): Burndy grounding products will change little, while Pin and Sleeve devices are being developed for higher amperages now and 'eventually the 800 VDC infrastructure'; for power skids the equipment on them 'will probably go through a lot of change' and Hubbell is working with customers and the gear manufacturers to prepare. Hubbell has exceeded the long-term targets it set in 2024 (restructuring, electrical segment unification 'still in the middle innings', DMC and NSI acquisitions), and ahead of the 2027 investor day 'our view is incrementally positive on what the targets are going to be going forward' because underlying demand is stronger than anticipated. CEO: Hubbell is seeing inflation this year, is pricing for it, and is 'seeing those prices stick'.

items.reason: The CEO spoke of inflation generally; 'metals' is not in the source.
items.evidence: when we see inflation happening, and we are certainly seeing that this year, where we price for it, and again, we are seeing those prices stick.
